toegepas.voor: ná die beginpunt en die v.C.-jare
toegepas.na: ná die beginpunt, en die v.C.-jare
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb ('die n.C.-jare kom' / 'die v.C.-jare kom').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required comma between two full clauses; meaning and protected forms untouched.

toegepas.voor: Op 'n tydlyn van links na regs staan
toegepas.na: Op 'n tydlyn wat van links na regs loop, staan
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Tydlyn van links na regs' is compressed and reads ambiguously; a short relative clause makes clear it is the direction the timeline runs.
toegepas.fout: 'n Tydlyn van links na regs' is compressed and makes a reader pause over whether it describes the line or its direction.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The short relative clause states the direction plainly, matches 'loop' in the later block, and keeps every protected word and the meaning intact.

toegepas.voor: Jy merk die gebeure op die tydlyn
toegepas.na: Jy plaas die gebeure op die tydlyn
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Merk ... by hulle eie jare' is slightly unidiomatic for putting events onto a line; 'plaas' is the natural verb here.
toegepas.fout: 'Jy merk die gebeure op die tydlyn' can be misread as the separable verb 'opmerk' (notice) on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Plaas' names the same action without the stumble and leaves 'tydlyn' and the rest of the sentence unchanged.

laat_vaar.voor: Die jare voor die beginpunt tel agteruit en nie vorentoe nie
laat_vaar.na: Die jare voor die beginpunt word agteruit getel en nie vorentoe nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: As written the years themselves do the counting; the passive says that we count them backwards, which is what is meant.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Intransitive 'tel agteruit' is natural Afrikaans (as in 'die klok tel af'); the passive is longer and stiffer for a Grade 4 reader.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Oordra' is the idiomatic Afrikaans verb for passing on heritage; 'aangee' suggests handing an object across.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Aangee' on its own reads like handing an object across rather than passing heritage on to later generations.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: This is a glossary definition, so even a sound verb improvement must go through the writer for every lesson at once.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: 'n Speurder soek leidrade in bronne en wil ook weet wanneer iets gebeur het.
vlae.rede: The lesson opens with 'n Speurder' without saying who the detective is in this lesson; it presumably refers to an earlier lesson's comparison, and a learner reading this lesson alone may not follow. Making it clear would mean adding content, so it is flagged, not changed.
